statusLabel: Tentative through the first budget hearing

displayPolicy.baseRelease: Keep the July 15 proposal as a fixed historical snapshot.
displayPolicy.amendments: Show later actions in a separate amendment ledger.
displayPolicy.releaseTotals: Do not calculate an amended Countywide total until the County publishes a restated total or every adjustment can be reconciled across funds.

sourceDocuments.label: Information for First Budget Hearing — FY 2026-27 Proposed Budget

publishedControlTotals.note: The amended schedule leaves the Countywide General Fund total unchanged. This is not the all-funds County budget total.

memoChanges.title: Clerk of the Court and Comptroller
memoChanges.summary: ERP responsibilities and staff move to the Clerk. The increase is fully offset by reductions in five County departments.

memoChanges.title: ERP Optimization capital program
memoChanges.summary: The existing capital program moves from Internal Compliance to the Clerk; this is not new capital spending.

memoChanges.title: Office of Management and Budget
memoChanges.summary: Budget-systems maintenance and support move from Internal Compliance to OMB.

memoChanges.title: Strategic Procurement → Internal Compliance
memoChanges.summary: The Contract Compliance and Monitoring section moves to Internal Compliance.

memoChanges.title: Animal Services
memoChanges.summary: South Florida SPCA funding moves from the Countywide nondepartmental CBO line into Animal Services. The department allocation becomes $350,000; the Countywide total does not change.

memoChanges.title: Community Services
memoChanges.summary: LIHEAP funding is reduced and six filled positions move to Housing and Community Development, where they are federally funded.

memoChanges.title: Housing and Community Development
memoChanges.summary: Legal Services of Greater Miami receives an additional $1 million for eviction-diversion work, using the General Fund portion of the Affordable Housing Trust Fund. Six positions transfer from Community Services.

memoChanges.title: Property Appraiser
memoChanges.summary: The State-approved authorized position count changes from 432 to 431.

hearingActions.title: PTP capital reallocation
hearingActions.summary: Funds designated for the Baylink branch transit corridor move to SMART Plan capital improvements.

hearingActions.title: Water and Sewer rate
hearingActions.summary: The 6 percent rate increase already included in the July proposal remains in the tentative budget.

pendingItems.title: Tax Collector school-millage commissions
pendingItems.summary: The Tax Collector agreed to waive commissions on voted school millages. The resulting revenue and expenditure changes were not included in the first memorandum.

pendingItems.title: Sheriff funding plan
pendingItems.summary: The Board directed the administration to identify legally available funds and prepare a plan addressing the Sheriff’s request.

pendingItems.title: MetroConnect and Metromover
pendingItems.summary: The Board requested further analysis. No fare or service figure from those discussions is treated as an approved budget change here.

pendingItems.title: Solid-waste follow-up
pendingItems.summary: A possible $60,000 allocation was left for the administration and sponsor to examine before the next changes memorandum.

sourceCaveats.title: The County memo conflicts on the LIHEAP funding source
sourceCaveats.summary: Page 4 describes a state-grant reduction, while the schedule on page 25 reduces Federal Grants. The $369,000 reduction is shown, but this site does not assign it to a funding category pending clarification.
